title: Megurine Luka — Accept Your Regrets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (She found out why they stopped receiving offers, but...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Light...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: An idol is a light.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
A light that can never go out.
A bright beacon of hope that has a duty to stay illuminated for the sake of their fans.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At no point can they go out and leave everybody wandering around in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Mr. Hiiragi said that...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Yes, I am inclined to agree with what he said.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Because that is the idealized version of an idol that the masses demand.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's more to being an idol than just that.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know Haruka and the others will...
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hello, Luka♪
Was Haruka okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She seems to be doing much better now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. She also told me about some very important things.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Very important things?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This is going to take a bit of time to explain, if none of you mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh... I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This Mr. Hiiragi must be doing everything in his power to make sure ReLight succeeds.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, and MORE MORE JUMP! is getting less work as a result! That seems really unfair.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: However, Haruka herself said that there's a clear skill gap between her group and his.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. And that, if one were asked to choose between MORE MORE JUMP! and ReLight, that would be the deciding factor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Didn't they all work so hard to prepare for Idol Lovers after being completely blown away by ReLight's performance during rehearsals?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪ I remember Airi saying that during practice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: As great as it was to get to collaborate on something with them, the thought of having to dance alongside them was a really scary prospect.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because they're so formidable...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Shizuku said something similar about that one girl from ReLight when it was decided that they'd appear together in that commercial, remember?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. She was worried that she didn't have what it took, and that she'd end up ruining the commercial...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I remember being impressed by ReLight during their joint performance, but I guess they really must be something else, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Has Haruka told the others about this already?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No... Not yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're going to be so sad.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is going to come as a bit of a shock to them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll get back up fairly quickly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because they're set on spreading hope to others as idols.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, that means we have to hold out on our end♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right! KAITO, let's get back to our dance training!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay! Can you keep coaching us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Len, that means we need to keep practicing as well! Let's make sure we're able to put on a beautiful dance together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Luka, can you keep coaching us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (After all, as the idols of this SEKAI, we need to keep doing our best to remain beacons of hope♪)
